jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Fintech Platform (m/f/n)
jobs.description:
Company Description

InPost Group is an innovative European out of home deliveries company, revolutionizing the way parcels are delivered to customers. With operations across several countries, our network of intelligent lockers provides customers with a fast, convenient, and secure delivery option. InPost Group is a publicly traded company, with a market capitalization of about $5 billion as of March 2023. With over 10,000 people worldwide, InPost Group is one of the largest out of home delivery providers in Europe, committed to providing sustainable and efficient delivery solutions to meet the evolving needs of customers in today's rapidly changing landscape.

We are a team that builds the best FMCG e-commerce in Poland.
We already have over 300,000 products
in our offer, we work with over 300 sellers
, and our mobile application has already been downloaded by almost 1.5 million users in Poland
. Due to the fact that our product consists of many elements that must work together efficiently and be managed effectively, we are looking for experienced consumer-focused (Web / Mobile App products) engineering leaders to join us in that journey
- heavily influence our future platform build, improve processes and help us deliver best customer experience in the market across all types of devices.

Job Description

InPost is building the FinTech platform that powers payments for one of Europe's largest logistics and e-commerce ecosystems. We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to become our organisation-wide technical authority - someone who can arbitrate architecture decisions across Payments Core, Merchant, and Consumer domains, and who has genuinely shipped AI-assisted engineering workflows in production, not just talked about them.

As Principal Software Engineer, you'll work directly with the Head of FinTech Engineering and business leadership, translating critical business goals - new product lines, regulatory deadlines, growth targets - into architecture decisions and roadmap input. You'll be the final word on cross-domain technical questions that no single team or Staff Engineer can resolve alone.

→ Hybrid working model:
preferably 1 day per week in the Warsaw or Cracow office
.

Responsibilities:

Serve as the single cross-domain technical authority, arbitrating architecture decisions across Payments Core, Merchant, and Consumer platform areas
Partner directly with the Head of Engineering and business leadership to turn business strategy into technical roadmap input
Author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and RFCs for organisation-wide decisions, with reasoning accessible to both engineers and business stakeholders
Own the agentic engineering harness at an organisational level — design, instrument, and continuously improve AI-assisted engineering workflows based on real production data
Identify and drive the adoption or deprecation of patterns across all teams, building the case and sequencing change without direct authority
Mentor Staff Engineers and Engineering Managers on architecture craft, technical communication, and agentic tooling

Qualifications

10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in cross-team technical leadership or architecture authority
5+ years designing distributed payments or fintech systems
3+ years of agentic/LLM engineering in production — shipped systems, not theoretical patterns
Deep knowledge of distributed systems architecture: event sourcing, CQRS, domain events, saga pattern
Experience designing APIs at an organisational boundary level — REST, async, and event-based contracts
Strong grasp of database trade-offs (relational, time-series, document, ledger-style) and cloud architecture evaluation (AWS/GCP/Azure) at organisation scale
Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, context management, and evaluation harnesses for AI-assisted engineering workflows
Excellent technical writing for mixed audiences — ADRs and RFCs that work for engineers and business leadership alike
English proficiency at B2 or above
University degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field

Nice to have:

3+ years in platform or internal developer tooling engineering
1+ years of agentic/LLM system design experience
PCI DSS / PSD2 architecture compliance experience from the design phase
BNPL or lending domain architecture experience
Open-source contributions or external technical publishing
Experience building or scaling an internal developer platform
Formal mentorship of Staff-level or EM-track engineers
Polish language skills

Additional Information

Opportunity to work in a diverse, international, and cross-functional environment, along with leading experts.
You work and learn from a senior leader and their leadership team, expanding your experience and exposure in the e-commerce and logistics industries.
 InPost is a growing company that offers its people an increasing number of opportunities in several locations in Europe.
Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits for people and investing in providing training opportunities for their development.
You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and the circular economy every day.
Excellent working environment and flexible hours
We offer B2B type of contract

Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage

jobs.title: .NET utvecklare - Open Banking
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med modern .NET-utveckling i ett område där teknik, innovation och finans möts? Vi söker en .NET-utvecklare till vårt Open Banking-team, där du får vara med och utveckla nästa generations lösningar för säker och smidig delning av finansiell information.

Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en del av vårt Open Banking-team, där du utvecklar moderna lösningar som möjliggör säker och smidig integration mellan banker, fintechbolag och andra externa aktörer.

Open Banking ingår i affärsområde Kund och Vardagsbank – en portfölj där det händer mycket och där teknisk utveckling och nya möjligheter står i fokus. I takt med att regelverk och möjligheterna att dela finansiell information utvecklas får du vara med och bygga nästa generations lösningar och bidra till bättre kundupplevelser.

Tyngdpunkten i rollen ligger på backendutveckling, men du kommer även att arbeta med frontend. Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta med både nyutveckling och vidareutveckling i ett område som är i ständig förändring.

Du Kommer Bland Annat Att

utveckla och vidareutveckla backendtjänster i .NET
bygga och förvalta API och integrationer mot externa aktörer
arbeta med nyutveckling av lösningar inom Open Banking
bidra till tekniska vägval, arkitektur och kvalitet i teamets lösningar
samarbeta nära utvecklare och andra kompetenser i teamet
vid behov även bidra inom frontendutveckling

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som är trygg inom C# och .NET. Du har ett starkt intresse för backendutveckling och tycker om att bygga stabila, säkra och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.

Vi Ser Att Du Har

flera års erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET
god erfarenhet av backendutveckling
erfarenhet av API och integrationer
erfarenhet av att arbeta med moderna utvecklingsmetoder och verktyg
god förståelse för kvalitet, säkerhet och testbar kod
goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

Erfarenhet av frontendutveckling är meriterande.

Vem är du?

Som person är du nyfiken och lösningsorienterad och tycker om att sätta dig in i både tekniska problem och verksamhetens behov. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete och bidrar gärna med idéer och perspektiv kring hur lösningar och arbetssätt kan förbättras.

Eftersom du blir en del av ett team där ni tillsammans ansvarar för både utveckling och kvalitet ser vi också att du trivs med att samarbeta, dela kunskap och hitta lösningar tillsammans med andra.

Vad händer nu?

I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Monika Olsén på monika.olsen@skandia.se.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Nina Fazeli på nina.fazeli@skandia.se.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

In this role you'll be a part of a great team that provide our users with world class geospatial data and features for Apple Maps around the globe. As a member in the team you will be developing applications and tools in a complex domain with large amount of data and with many exiting challenges to solve that makes a difference for our users.

Responsibilities

Identify requirements of new features, and propose design and solution.
Implement features in a suitable programming language.
Take ownership of delivering features and improvements solving the business problem at hand.

Must-have Qualifications

Very strong in programming, system design and problem solving.
Professional experience from writing code in Scala, Java, C++ or similar.
Professional experience with Spark or Flink.
Ability to take ownership, identify requirements, prioritise and make progress in an environment with limited given input.
Fluent communication in English with a sense for listen to others as well as getting you message through in a crisp way.
Experience in cross team collaboration and communication.

Extra Merit Qualifications

Experience of data engineering in large and complex domains.
Experience of data engineering in large and complex domains.
Experience with frameworks like Akka, Play (Scala), Spring.
Experience with GIS, Geographical Data and Toolkits such as JTS, ArcGIS, QGIS,

OpenJump etc.

Information

Language Requirements: Fluent English (mandatory), Swedish
Scope: 100%
Location: Malmö, 3 days on site
Start: Immediate
Duration: 12 months, with possible extension

jobs.title: Intern, Software Engineer in Test [AEC Autocad Engineering]
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101362

Position Overview

AutoCAD, the leading software for Computer-Aided Design, is seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer in Test intern to join our team to work on the test automation project for AutoCAD Toolset products.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to learn automation harness and test cases development with AI Tools, software automation process and agile process in software industry while guided by experienced automation developers. You will also learn about Autodesk flagship products: AutoCAD and Toolsets.

On-site in-person recruitment drive starts from 9 October - 6 November 2026

Responsibilities

Understand different automation frameworks
Understand different automation test cases
Create different automation test cases with AI Tools
Use Jenkins pipeline to test the test cases to make sure they are stable
Document the technical details for future reference

Minimum Qualifications

You must be enrolled in a full-time Bachelor's Program in Computer Science or Engineering or other relevant fields
You must either be in your penultimate or final year of studies, and will be graduating in 2027 or 2028
Understanding of object-oriented design, data structures and algorithms
Experience of working with languages like C++/C#/Java/Python etc
Self-motivated and eager to learn new technologies
Internship period: 11 January - 25 June 2027 (fixed dates)

Preferred Qualifications

Passion for developing robust software and writing maintainable code
Keen interest in learning new tools and technologies
Experience using AI Tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc)
Flexibility under changing conditions and ability to multi-task between projects
Fluent oral and written communication skills in English language
Self-motivated with positive attitude

Learning Benefits

Hands-on experience with test automation development with AI Tools
Hands-on experience with test automation on Azure environment
Learn best practices in writing and maintaining test automation
Understand the role of test automation in software development process
Exposure to industry leading flagship products in AutoCAD Family

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience, educational level, and geographic location.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.
